grammar.explanation: 往东走 places 往 plus direction before the motion verb. 往公园走 means move towards the park; it does not prove arrival. 在公园 says where a person is. A route can say 从学校往东走, keeping the start and direction separate. Distance and road availability are additional information, not supplied by 往.

wǒ wǎng gōng yuán zǒu , hái méi yǒu dào .
examples.en: I am walking towards the park and have not arrived yet.

examples.zh: 往前走五十米，再问入口。
examples.py: wǎng qián zǒu wǔ shí mǐ , zài wèn rù kǒu .
examples.en: Walk forward fifty metres, then ask about the entrance.

commonMistakes.wrong: 我往公园，所以我已经在公园里。
commonMistakes.why: Moving towards a destination does not assert being inside it.

grammar.purpose: Orient an action or direct it towards a target
grammar.explanation: 向左看 gives the direction of looking; 向老师问路 names the person addressed. 向 can introduce direction or an action’s target, so the following verb matters. 向东走 describes movement; 向东看 describes looking. Do not equate left with east without a known orientation. Here the map is explicitly north-up.

examples.py: zài lù kǒu xiàng zuǒ kàn .

examples.zh: 向东看，公园在学校对面。
examples.py: xiàng dōng kàn , gōng yuán zài xué xiào duì miàn .
examples.en: Look east; the park is opposite the school.

commonMistakes.wrong: 向东看，就是已经走到公园。
commonMistakes.why: Looking east is not walking there.

dialogue.title: The open gate matters
dialogue.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.
dialogue.purpose: Find the available entrance rather than following a stale route.

lines.zh: 从学校怎样去公园？
lines.py: cóng xué xiào zěn yàng qù gōng yuán ?
lines.en: How do I get to the park from school?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 先看这张地图，上边是北，右边是东。
lines.py: xiān kàn zhè zhāng dì tú , shàng biān shì běi , yòu biān shì dōng .
lines.en: First look at this map: the top is north, the right is east.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 公园在学校对面，是往东走吗？
lines.py: gōng yuán zài xué xiào duì miàn , shì wǎng dōng zǒu ma ?
lines.en: The park is opposite the school. Do I walk east?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 对，往东走。但今天西门关了，要去东门。
lines.py: duì , wǎng dōng zǒu . dàn jīn tiān xī mén guān le , yào qù dōng mén .
lines.en: Yes, walk east. But the west gate is closed today; use the east gate.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 导航让我走西门。
lines.py: dǎo háng ràng wǒ zǒu xī mén .
lines.en: Navigation sends me to the west gate.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 那是以前的路线，先看新的通知。
lines.py: nà shì yǐ qián de lù xiàn , xiān kàn xīn de tōng zhī .
lines.en: That is the earlier route; check the new notice first.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 从这里到东门多远？
lines.py: cóng zhè lǐ dào dōng mén duō yuǎn ?
lines.en: How far is it from here to the east gate?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 两公里。东门前五十米有路口，先看清楚再过街。
lines.py: liǎng gōng lǐ . dōng mén qián wǔ shí mǐ yǒu lù kǒu , xiān kàn qīng chǔ zài guò jiē .
lines.en: Two kilometres. There is an intersection fifty metres before the east gate; look carefully before crossing.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 花园和动物园都在里面吗？
lines.py: huā yuán hé dòng wù yuán dōu zài lǐ miàn ma ?
lines.en: Are the garden and zoo both inside?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 不是。花园在公园西北，动物园在地图东北，是另一个地方。
lines.py: bù shì . huā yuán zài gōng yuán xī běi , dòng wù yuán zài dì tú dōng běi , shì lìng yī gè dì fāng .
lines.en: No. The garden is in the northwest of the park; the zoo is northeast on the map, a different place.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 我骑车过去，可以从公路进吗？
lines.py: wǒ qí chē guò qù , kě yǐ cóng gōng lù jìn ma ?
lines.en: I will cycle there. Can I enter from the highway?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 先向工作人员问路，入口不能猜。
lines.py: xiān xiàng gōng zuò rén yuán wèn lù , rù kǒu bù néng cāi .
lines.en: Ask staff for directions first; do not guess the entrance.
lines.speaker: b

lines.en: The garden is northwest inside the park; the zoo is northeast on the map.

lines.py: cóng xué xiào wǎng dōng zǒu , kě yǐ qù gōng yuán .

lines.py: jīn tiān xī mén guān bì , zhǐ néng cóng dōng mén jìn .

lines.py: wǔ shí mǐ shì dōng mén qián de lù kǒu dào dōng mén de jù lí .
lines.en: Fifty metres is the distance from the intersection in front to the east gate.

lines.zh: 坐地铁、坐船还是骑车，都先问新的入口。
lines.py: zuò dì tiě , zuò chuán hái shi qí chē , dōu xiān wèn xīn de rù kǒu .
lines.en: Whether taking metro, boat or bicycle, first ask about the updated entrance.
